thread:
sophie: Quick follow-up from the INF-2024-07 postmortem. We still need clear owners and deadlines for the remediation items. Can people pick owners in this thread?
maya: Happy to help coordinate cross-team comms and status updates.
jin: I'll own the KV TTL audit and the initial read-only logs.
omar: I'll take the caching strategy write-up and the model quantization rollback checklist.
leah: I'll create the Jira tickets and break them into test/dev/verify subtasks.
ryan: I'll own the canary rollback automation and rollout plan. ETA for a staging toggle: 3 days.
kate: SRE will be consulted on rollout; I'll be a reviewer (C) and will add monitoring rules.
sophie: Proposed short RACI: audit (R=jin, A=leah, C=kate, I=sophie/maya), rollback automation (R=ryan, A=ryan, C=jin, I=leah), strategy (R=omar, A=sophie, C=kate, I=platform-eng). Any objections?
jin: Good by me. Running initial read-only audit tomorrow: command: ```python infra/tools/kv_audit.py --lookback=7d --upload=gs://redwood-audit/kv-2026-03.json```
leah: I'll create tickets now. Will attach acceptance criteria + test plan.
jira-bot: Created INF-2401 (KV TTL audit), INF-2402 (Canary rollback automation), INF-2403 (Caching & quantization strategy doc).
ryan: For INF-2402 acceptance: staged rollout 10%->50%->100% with automatic rollback on error delta >0.4% and latency spike >30ms for 5m.
kate: Add alert: prefix-miss >1% sustained for 5m triggers page to oncall and starts automated rollback.
omar: Noting pattern: three recent deploys with quantized model updates coincided with TTL drift. I'll add a recurrence analysis section in INF-2403 and tag past incidents.
maya: I'll own communications: drafting the stakeholder update and customer impact note.
sophie: Deadlines: INF-2401 due 2026-03-30, INF-2402 due 2026-03-27, INF-2403 draft by 2026-04-10. If this timeline doesn't work ping me.
jin: I'll set milestones in INF-2401: audit run (T+1), findings summary (T+3), patch plan (T+5).
leah: Subtasks: QA matrix, rollout checklist, runbook updates. Assigning QA to @qa-team.
ryan: I'll open a draft PR for the canary toggle and add integration tests. Will link the PR in INF-2402.
kate: I'll add monitoring dashboards and a weekly "recurrence" digest to our ops board. Can someone add me as watcher on all three tickets?
leah: Added Kate + eng-sre watchers. Linking postmortem doc: https://docs.redwood.com/postmortems/INF-2024-07.
opsbot: Reminder: oncall shift next week: jin -> ryan -> kate.
sophie: Hand-off summary: Jin = audit & patch validation, Ryan = automation & rollout, Omar = strategy & recurrence analysis, Leah = ticket ownership and QA coordination, Maya = comms. We'll do a 30m remediation triage on Thursday 10:30 to walk acceptance criteria.
jin: Acknowledged. I'll kick off the read-only audit tomorrow and post results to INF-2401.
omar: Pushed skeleton for INF-2403. Please review and add references to related incidents.
ryan: PR opened (draft) for toggle and integration tests. Adding rollback metrics to CI.
maya: Draft stakeholder note posted in INF-2401; feedback welcome.
sophie: If no objections I'll mark these in the postmortem tracker as assigned and set weekly reminders until closed. Closing thread unless someone needs to raise scope. :white_check_mark:
ryan: No objections. :+1:
kate: Fine by me. Adding alert playbook notes to INF-2402.
jira-bot: INF-2401: In Progress. INF-2402: In Progress. INF-2403: In Progress.
